name: pod-v1
description: Fixed opponent pool for all Vibefish win-rate reporting: four Forge-bundled Commander precons. If this ever changes, that is a new pod with a new name and history restarts.

seats.note: Chatterfang, Squirrel General is in the 99 as shipped

scheme.baseline: All four seats play each other. Expected win share is 25% each; the measured spread is the pod's own power calibration.
scheme.deck_under_test: The tested deck takes one seat and the precons rotate out one at a time, so each precon sits out exactly one quarter of the games. Seat order rotates every game.
scheme.game_counts: Multiples of four, so every precon sits out equally.
